assets.preparation: Skinning baked at the bind pose, the four primitives merged into one geometry, and the body turned to face +z. A pool of sixty birds cannot afford a skeleton each: the wings beat in the vertex shader instead, so what ships is one static mesh in a spread-wing pose.
